forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {禁|きん}じていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to prohibit, to forbid, to ban
definitions.explanation: To officially or authoritatively forbid something. Used for rules, laws, and regulations.

definitions.gloss: to suppress, to hold back (an emotion)
definitions.explanation: To restrain oneself from expressing a feeling. Most commonly appears in the set phrase ...を{禁|きん}じ{得|え}ない (cannot help but feel...).

examples.japanese: ⟦{喫煙|きつえん}→喫煙：17580_kitsuen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{禁|きん}じる。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{釣|つ}り→釣り：03439_tsuri⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{禁|きん}じられている→禁ずる：19600_kinzuru⟧。
examples.english: Fishing is prohibited in this area.

examples.japanese: ⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{未成年者|みせいねんしゃ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{飲酒|いんしゅ}→飲酒：08635_inshu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{禁|きん}じられている→禁ずる：19600_kinzuru⟧。
examples.english: Drinking by minors is prohibited by law.

examples.japanese: ⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{禁|きん}じ→禁ずる：19600_kinzuru⟧⟦{得|え}なかった→得る：02014_eru⟧。
examples.english: I could not hold back my tears.

examples.japanese: ⟦{驚|おどろ}き→驚き：02562_odoroki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{禁|きん}じ→禁ずる：19600_kinzuru⟧⟦{得|え}ない→得る：02014_eru⟧。
examples.english: I cannot help but feel astonished.

examples.japanese: ⟦その→その：00993_sono⟧⟦{悲惨|ひさん}→悲惨：12633_hisan⟧な⟦{状況|じょうきょう}→状況：01576_joukyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}て→見る：00283_miru⟧、⟦{同情|どうじょう}→同情：11954_doujou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{念|ねん}→念：12766_nen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{禁|きん}じ→禁ずる：19600_kinzuru⟧⟦{得|え}なかった→得る：02014_eru⟧。
examples.english: Seeing that tragic situation, I could not help but feel sympathy.

notes:
USAGE:
An ichidan verb. The variant ⟦{禁|きん}ずる→禁ずる：19600_kinzuru⟧ (classical form) also exists but {禁|きん}じる is standard in modern Japanese.

Sense 2 almost always appears in the fixed pattern ～⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{禁|きん}じ→禁ずる：19600_kinzuru⟧⟦{得|え}ない→得る：02014_eru⟧ (cannot suppress, cannot help but feel). This is a formal, written expression.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{喫煙|きつえん}→喫煙：17580_kitsuen⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{禁|きん}じる: to prohibit smoking
- ⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{禁|きん}じる: to prohibit by law
- ⟦{涙|なみだ}→涙：02235_namida⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{禁|きん}じ→禁ずる：19600_kinzuru⟧⟦{得|え}ない→得る：02014_eru⟧: cannot hold back tears
- ⟦{驚|おどろ}き→驚き：02562_odoroki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{禁|きん}じ→禁ずる：19600_kinzuru⟧⟦{得|え}ない→得る：02014_eru⟧: cannot help but be amazed
